ctx.x: And they happened to be lucky they was very flexible too, because almost was a contradiction to put a tenor-sax and a trumpet player playing against our rhythm that is so complicated. Is complicated for the people that play. (chuckle)

Machito, that was such a great recording that I was in North Carolina - I was in the 82nd. Airborne Paratroops - and nothing up to that time had made me want to go AWOL until I heard that 78 for the first time. (Machito, laughs) It reminded me of home, of New York City and everything that I missed, you know, and the only time I went home was everytime was finding out where the Machito orchestra would be playing and hoping that I could hear 'Cubop City'. 'Cubop City' did a lot for the Machito orchestra, because…
